The pair is the evidence that two scenes in one campaign stay apart, from both sides rather than one.

What it exercises that act-healer's seat cannot: act-goblin-archer is a NON-party actor in this same scene, and both tokens move (steps 13-15; step 12 is a move the player is denied, so it produces no event). So this seat should be shown the goblin when it comes into view and have it WITHDRAWN when it leaves. act-healer stands alone in camp and never sees anyone, so no transition of that kind appears there.

Before Asme is added at world seq 4 this seat has no eyes, so no scene, token or move reaches it. The sitting and the party ROSTER still do -- which is why this stream names act-healer, whom Asme never sees. Narration would too, since classify forwards it unconditionally, but no golden here has a narration before a party member is added, so nothing in this corpus demonstrates it. That is roster-gated exposure, not a sight leak, and sub-project 14's plan records it as a product question rather than a defect.
